title: I’m leaving home for a while + a little update on me
en: hello everyone i just wanted to give you a little bit of an update because i'm going to be leaving home for a little bit the air quality over here has been really bad and there's so much haze and just smog in the air and it's been pretty hard to tolerate i'm usually fairly tolerant i've been here a few summers either visiting or living here and we've had smoke before and i've gotten through it pretty well but this summer it's been different because it's been so close to home and so i decided that with my boyfriend and i we would go to the west coast for a little bit and to distract ourselves a little bit from everything going on over here and get some fresh air which we both really need he's a surveyor and he works outdoors so he's had to wear a really big mask for most of it and i can't imagine it's comfortable so i think we're both really going to enjoy having a bit of a break and getting the crisp sea air which i'm very excited for of course i wanted to give a little more of an update in this video since obviously it's it's a little bit different it's really hard to film out here with all the smoke so i did want to tell you guys a couple shenanigans i've been up to recently and that is i have been raising caterpillars being able to raise caterpillars um has been

a possibly one of the weirdest things i've done so far living here i will explain i will tell the story from the beginning my parents had guests over at their house and that night the porch light was left on and so that morning i went over there to visit because it was during the heatwave and i was coming over a lot to enjoy the ac and so i noticed that a what i believe is a one-eyed sphinx moth was uh at the door and was right under the lamp and looked very exhausted she had been very distracted by the light that had been left on and she had also been heavily pregnant and so she had left all these little eggs on a windowsill nearby i felt really bad because moss like that should leave their eggs on trees for example the sphinx moths eat willow leaves and so she if she hadn't been distracted by the light she would have probably flown to a nearby willow tree and had her babies there the eggs from the moth have a residue on them that makes them stick to anything they come in contact with and so it would be really tricky to remove them from the windowsill and move them to a willow tree without breaking most of the eggs so what i did was i put fresh willow leaves around the eggs waiting for them to be born

and then i had about 60 caterpillars after about a week or two and they were all climbing all over the windowsill and i didn't know what to do with them so i ended up just putting them in a big jar with a bunch of willow leaves so they could eat the leaves while the other caterpillars were being born one percent of baby caterpillars actually make it to adulthood and that's because the majority of them feed birds and feed other creatures and it's a very important part of nature's life cycle and so i went and i put a bunch in the trees and i just kept two because i thought it would be really great to take some photographs of the caterpillars and show the whole process of the caterpillars transforming into moths to my former students because they're really interested in that whole life process and they're always so curious and none of them as far as i know have had the opportunity to witness caterpillars transform and so i wanted to do that as well anyway i hope to share with you an update on the caterpillar situation and also i will be sharing with you next week some highlights hopefully from my little trip and i appreciate you watching this all the way through if you've lasted this long because i clearly didn't have a plan for this video but i still wanted to share at least something with you

last but not least i wanted to follow the rest of this video with a little clip of one of the songs that my brother recently composed he's a very talented musician he recently made a lullaby that i've been listening to and it has brought me so much comfort during this strange strange time in the valley and i i really wanted to share this because i just thought it was beautiful so i hope you enjoy it and if you want to get updates on him you can of course follow him on instagram and get in contact with him but anyway i hope you have a wonderful day and you enjoy the music goodbye it's if we lose we won't be too far

zh: 大家好，我只是想向大家通报一些最新情况，因为我要离开家一段时间，这里的空气质量非常糟糕，空气中有太多的雾霾，而且空气中只有烟雾，这很难忍受。我通常相当宽容，我已经在这里待了几个夏天，无论是来这里旅游还是住在这里，我们以前也抽烟过，我已经很好地度过了，但今年夏天情况有所不同，因为它离家很近，所以我决定和我男朋友一起去西海岸呆一会儿，分散一下自己对这里发生的一切的注意力，呼吸新鲜空气，我们都非常需要他是一名测量员，他在户外工作，所以他大部分时间都必须戴上一个很大的口罩，我无法想象它会舒服，所以我想我们都会很享受休息一下，呼吸新鲜的海洋空气，我对此感到非常兴奋，当然我想多给一点这个视频的更新，因为显然它有点不同，真的很难在这里拍摄所有的烟雾，所以我确实想告诉你们一些我最近一直在做的恶作剧，那就是我一直在饲养毛毛虫能够饲养毛毛虫嗯一直是

这可能是我迄今为止住在这里做过的最奇怪的事情之一，我会解释一下，我将从一开始就讲述这个故事，我父母在他们的房子里接待了客人，那天晚上门廊的灯还亮着，所以那天早上我去那里参观，因为当时正值热浪，我经常过来享受空调，所以我注意到一只我认为是单眼狮身人面像飞蛾就在门口，就在灯下，看起来很疲惫，她很心烦意乱灯光一直亮着，她也怀孕了，所以她把所有这些小蛋留在附近的窗台上，我感觉很糟糕，因为像这样的苔藓应该把蛋留在树上，例如狮身人面像飞蛾吃柳叶，所以如果她没有被灯光分散注意力，她可能会飞到附近的一棵柳树上，让她的孩子在那里生孩子，飞蛾的蛋上有残留物，使它们粘在接触到的任何东西上，所以这真的很糟糕。很难将它们从窗台上移到柳树上而不打破大部分鸡蛋，所以我所做的就是在鸡蛋周围放上新鲜的柳叶等待它们出生

大约一两周后，我有了大约 60 条毛毛虫，它们都爬满了窗台，我不知道该怎么处理它们，所以我最后只是把它们放在一个装有一堆柳叶的大罐子里，这样它们就可以在其他毛毛虫出生的时候吃叶子。百分之一的毛毛虫宝宝实际上能活到成年，那是因为它们中的大多数喂养鸟类和其他生物，这是大自然生命周期的一个非常重要的组成部分，所以我去了，我在树上放了一堆，我只保留了两个，因为我觉得拍一些毛毛虫的照片并向我以前的学生展示毛毛虫变成飞蛾的整个过程真的很棒，因为他们对整个生命过程非常感兴趣，他们总是很好奇，据我所知，他们中没有人有机会亲眼目睹毛毛虫的转变，所以我也想这样做，无论如何我希望与你们分享毛毛虫情况的最新情况和另外，下周我将与您分享我的小旅行中的一些亮点，如果您坚持了这么长时间，我感谢您一路观看这个视频，因为我显然没有制作该视频的计划，但我仍然想与您分享至少一些东西

最后但并非最不重要的一点是，我想在这个视频的其余部分播放我哥哥最近创作的一首歌曲的一个小片段，他是一位非常有才华的音乐家，他最近创作了一首我一直在听的摇篮曲，在山谷里这个奇怪的奇怪时刻给我带来了很多安慰，我真的很想分享这个，因为我只是觉得它很美丽，所以我希望你喜欢它，如果你想了解他的最新动态，你当然可以在 Instagram 上关注他并与他联系，但无论如何我希望你有美好的一天，你享受音乐，再见，如果我们输了，我们也不会走得太远
除了我不只是在乎告诉他们我发誓要找到我能给予的一切跨越天空的小丑给你这是我爱的摇篮曲
